name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for Moonlight Study
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement

---

**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. E.g. "I'm always
frustrated when …"

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features
you've considered.

**How it fits the project**
Moonlight Study is a **local, offline, on-device** study companion. If your
request would require cloud services, collections of user data, or would
undermine privacy, explain why the trade-off is worth it (or how it can be
done offline).

**Additional context**
Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
